[i]Musi Teoji user:[/i] the explosive artifact used by [b]Kwang Pok.[/b]
[i]So were really going to destroy this house?[/i]
Kwang asked, glancing at the Minister of Architecture and the Sea, Kim Chue Il.The minister nodded.
[i]Seems the government really loves having a demolisher on payroll.[/i]
Kwang smiled. He pulled a revolver from his waist, blew softly into the cylinder, then aimed it casually at the ruined house.
[i]Thank you for your service.[/i]
the minister said.
[i]The former owners finally moved out. This place used to be troublesome. Now, you may destroy it. We need to build a new urban terminal here.[/i]
Kwang hesitated.
[i]Why me[/i]?
He asked before continuing.
[i]Youre already paying me for doing almost nothing. And its not like the government  lacks the equipment for destroying this kind of build.[/i]
The minister frowned, then answered bluntly:
[i]You know, my time is short.[/i]
He adjusted his coat and smiled slightly.
[i]I simply can't wait much more for the whole equipment arrive.[/i]
Kwang would look down to his gun and move it up towards the house, adjusted his fingers in between the trigger and pressed, his revolver was exactly made to pressure his breath into pressure projectile.
Kwang inhaled slowly. The air tasted like rust, salt, and old paint. He felt the familiar pressure building behind his teeth, warm and volatile, like a storm curling inside his lungs.
[I]You know, Minister[/I]
He didnt look away from the house.
[I]Most people get nervous when theyre about to erase a place from existence.[/I]
[I]Government men always speak of places like they are nothing but files.[/I]
He said softly, then started moving out his fingers as counting examples:
[I]Troublesome....inconvenient....delayed.[/I]
The Minister exhaled through his nose, unimpressed.
[I] This place is just occupying place, it not historical, just some people who moved right days after it demolition be approved, and forced us to wait over 2 decades.[/I] 
he replied.
[I]What matters here, is what replaces this.[/I]
Kwang let out a quiet chuckle. The sound vibrated oddly in his chest, as if it carried weight.
[I]Funny,[/I]
He muttered then Kwang finally looked at the minister .His eyes were calm, almost bored, his fingers tightened a little more.
[I]Anything you want to say to it?[/I]
[I]Fire.[/I] 
The Minister answered immediately.
Kwang smiled into response, then pressed completely the trigger, the projectile was invisible, a mass of air moving towards the house doors, and soon.
[b]*KABOOM!!!][/b]*
The pressure hit the house like a solid thing. The front doors were torn inward, wood splintering as if peeled apart by invisible hands. The windows burst at once, glass spraying outward in a bright, deadly rain. The walls buckled, cracked, and folded into themselves, bricks snapping loose and flying as the roof sagged.
Bricks would go launched into direction of the minister and Kwang, but the last only extended his hand to the bricks with open palms and a explosion would surge making it into ashes.
And at the end as the dust settled, there was no house, just some broken pieces of glass and bricks, there was nothing inside, or if there was it was destroyed by the explosion, the minister would look to Kwang again.
[i]You deserves a raise for such good work.[/i]

You are controlling their actions by voiding them breaking your laws.

If you choose to treat law breaking as a declaration of war then that is YOUR decision, but you can also choose to not do anything and simply turn a blind eye. You can't be like "Well no, I don't want to do any wars so your not allowed to defy my laws", that's the same as saying "You're not allowed to have aggressive relations with my nation because then I would have to respond and I don't want to, so I'm voiding it."
Either you enforce your laws and punish whoever breaks them (war, sanctions, condemnation, whatever) or just let those laws be suggestions that others may follow. You can't force others to follow your laws, even if crossing your waters, just as they can't force you to declare war because they officially called the Bobian government a poopie head or decided to ignore all your laws.

TLDR; Others can choose if they respect your laws or not, you can't force them to not break your laws, let them violate your laws or have some form of enforcing laws IC.
